Thank you for posting a review and I am sorry that you are unhappy with both us and urgent care.

You rang us on 25.09.2025, three days later, at 12.50 to explain that you had been recommended to go to Urgent Care a few days earlier and were still in a lot of pain. There was some confusion over whether you had attended Queen Elizabeth or not as they had sent us a letter saying you did not attend – on further examination it appears that this was Queen Elizabeth closing off the referral that 111 had made on 22.09.2025 as you had not attended.

I hope you can see from the above that we did try to help you with your problems. You were put on the Duty Doctor list on the day you rang with the advice given being that you attend Urgent Care.
